sentences.en: The heart-shaped pond is the pride of the royal couple.
sentences.zh: 那颗心形的池塘是王室夫妇引以为傲的事物。

sentences.en: His pride did not allow him to take the money.
sentences.zh: 他的自尊使他无法接受这笔钱。

sentences.en: The Japanese pride themselves on Mt. Fuji, a cone-shaped mountain.
sentences.zh: 日本人以富士山为荣，这是一座锥形的山峰。
